metadata.title: Using machine learning to predict UK and Japanese secondary students' life satisfaction in PISA 2018

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values handling is not applicable because the dependent variable is the PISA 2018 life satisfaction scale score derived from student self-reports, and the paper does not describe using PV-based achievement scaling.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses student-level models without mentioning any multilevel modelling or consideration of school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation using nested cross-validation, which does not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.
